Master of Science in Physics
Master of Science in Physics
Gain analytical and problem-solving skills to excel in advanced roles in physics research and education.
For decades, our M.S. in physics has been highly ranked by the American Institute of Physics (AIP). Join us to benefit from our expertly crafted curriculum and to collaborate with faculty at the cutting edge of research in condensed matter physics, accelerator physics and elementary particles/fields. You’ll focus your studies by choosing a specialization in professional physics, interdisciplinary physics, quantum science and technology or physics teaching/secondary education.
We also participate in two traineeship programs – the NIU-UIC Graduate Traineeship Program (C2-THE-P2 program) and the Chicagoland Accelerator Science Traineeship Program (CAST program).

How to Apply
You can apply if you have a B.S. in physics. Outstanding candidates from related fields with substantial course work in physics will also be considered.
You’ll apply through the Graduate School.
Fall application deadline: Feb. 1
Spring deadline: Aug. 15
Application Materials
Your application materials will include:
Two letters of recommendation
Personal statement (250-750 words) that outlines your preparation for graduate study in physics, your goals for graduate school and beyond, and why you believe our program can best help you meet those goals
Current resume or CV
Physics GRE scores (optional) to strengthen your application (use institution code 1559 when sending scores, NIU does not require department codes)
General GRE scores are not required and will not be used for admission purposes.
Costs and Funding
Our competitive tuition and fees helps ensure an excellent return on the investment of your time and resources. Learn about additional funding opportunities for graduate students.
The department also offers Albright Travel Awards to support travel to conferences to report on your research.
Curriculum and Requirements
You must satisfy the requirements in your specialization, submit a thesis and pass an oral examination. You must also pass a physics proficiency exam or waive this requirement by submitting a satisfactory physics GRE score.

Faculty
Our faculty bring diverse experiences and scholarship from various areas across physics, including condensed matter physics, elementary particles and fields, accelerator physics and physics education research.
